caption: The drawing features a group of people, in which the central figure is a man with a halo wearing a long, reddish-brown robe and carrying a large, brown wooden cross. This man is shown leaning forward and is bound with a rope held by another man wearing an orange sash and boots. Next to the central figure, another man, dressed in an orange-red garment, is helping support the cross. The surrounding figures are dressed in a variety of robes in colors such as blue, red, white, and green. Some are wearing hats or helmets in shades of red, blue, white, and black. Several figures in the background hold spears or staffs, and some appear to be conversing or gesturing. To the right side of the image, a woman in a blue garment with a red cloak is accompanied by other figures in similar colors. The composition is tightly packed, with figures overlapping, and the background appears to be an architectural structure with columns and a decorated upper border in soft pink and brown. The colors throughout the drawing are earthy and muted, with predominance of brown, red, blue, and cream tones.
title: Station of the Cross No. 5: "Jesus is Assisted in Carrying His Cross"
